training_collection_200.usage_scope: No collection stage token or latency cost is estimated; only labels and exact fixed Critic call decisions are used.

selected_threshold.selection_objective: maximize corrected-degraded; ties use lower Critic call rate

learnability_assessment.basis: OOF threshold has positive corrected-degraded and the independently evaluated Learned Gate also has positive net benefit.
learnability_assessment.caveat: The signal is based on 200 training and 100 policy-selection validation samples; this Probe remains deployable=false and final_test=false.
